summary: Executed the one remaining open thread — the repair path I had only stated from source — by extending the forgotten-added-voter harness with a repair phase. In the construction-time run the stale leader was stopped, the correctly configured members reconnected and elected B, B's AddVoter E succeeded, and the stale node restarted on its own stores ended with five members including the previously forgotten D and the new E: a later configuration entry replicated by a correct leader does restore a stale node, which bounds the persistence claim I had corrected earlier. The revision is submitted as a successor of the current understate experiment with the four earlier comparisons preserved and one added (the repaired configuration must contain all five members); the interpretation replaces the source-only limitation with the construction-time result and marks its retained receipt as pending.
